metadata.name: InitialState
metadata.displayName: Initial state and the state bridge
metadata.description: Guides > Initial state. Dedicated page for a test's initialState and the state bridge (jsonui-test-runner spec §10). Ten sections: what it does, how to write it (file level, case level under caseIsolation reopen, the shallow merge), keys and the class table with the fixed rejection reasons, when the app applies the values and the gate it shares with the screen marker, the receipt the driver waits for and where the bridge lives per platform, reading state back without a provider, flows (viewModels, the removed initialState.screen, ignored references), the launch sequence and the web runner's afterLaunch, what validate checks (measured output), and what it does not cover. ~11-min read.
